rationale: Independently test data access and original-publication vintage integrity for Bitcoin realized capitalization, MVRV and spent-profit metrics before model-fitting, following v8.18b macro-factor review.
provider: Coin Metrics Community v4 https://community-api.coinmetrics.io/v4, no API key; metric availability determined by official catalog, not invented.
query: Try original Coin Metrics community catalog list BTC metric availability; sample 5 known 1d historical windows only if catalog advertises asset metric. Preserve source raw bodies and per-response SHA; report failed sources without fabricated history.
vintageGuard: Current Community API reconstruction is not as-of 2012 published metric even when observation date is 2012. Realized capitalization first discussed 2018. No ex-ante backtest uses old reconstructed metric as an authentic contemporaneous release.
externalPIT: Glassnode provides explicitly append-only PiT metrics, but APIs require service authentication; without authorized access mark GLASSNODE_PIT_UNAVAILABLE and do not fetch private endpoints nor ask user for secret in chat.
quality: Only 5 historical 1-month sampling windows, no score from selected events, no claim model precision, no concatenation across changed price/reference providers.
archive: R2 raw catalog/source snapshots with SHA readback, research report and manifest; no on-chain predictor activation.
safety: RESEARCH_ONLY no account, futures, NAV, Master, Detector, prices of active portfolio, P&L, risk limits changed.
